title: festuca durandoi subsp. livida
intro: Festuca durandoi subsp. livida, commonly known as Alpine Fescue, is a subspecies of grass native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestive function, and aid in the treatment of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Festuca durandoi subsp. livida include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of coughs, colds, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
